details:
As mentioned in the following feedback posts:

https://feedback.vrchat.com/feature-requests/p/id-like-you-to-revert-it-to-something-closer-to-the-previous-nameplate

https://feedback.vrchat.com/feature-requests/p/new-ui-needs-bigger-text-option-for-accessibility

https://feedback.vrchat.com/feature-requests/p/reverting-the-menu-and-ui-to-the-version-prior-to-202631-update

There are many voices from the community stating that the visibility of the nameplates has decreased and the UI can no longer be operated intuitively.

Instead of changing everything all at once, wouldn't it be better to allow users to toggle between UI versions so that the old and new designs can coexist for a time?

https://feedback.vrchat.com/feature-requests/p/id-like-you-to-revert-it-to-something-closer-to-the-previous-nameplate　

https://feedback.vrchat.com/feature-requests/p/new-ui-needs-bigger-text-option-for-accessibility

https://feedback.vrchat.com/feature-requests/p/reverting-the-menu-and-ui-to-the-version-prior-to-202631-update

にもあるようにネームプレートの視認性　UIの直感的操作が出来なくなっているとコミュニティからかなりの声があります。

一括で変更ではなく、一度UIの切り替えが出来るようにして

新しいのと古いのを混在させてもいいのでは？と思います。

@Tupper - VRChat Head of Community
title: Feedback on the Current Nameplate and UI　ネームプレートとUIのフィードバックについて
